01_safe_start.note: Wall fixtures sit on their walls: world_decor centred a fixture at 64 - B/2, legacy's horizon (48 + 16) fixed in, so on the slim horizon (60) every sign drew 12 px high and a distant one rose off its wall into the ceiling. It now uses HORIZON + 16; only fixture pixels move (12 px down), legacy is byte-identical.

07_sentinel_encounter.note: Enemy size ladder: the middle distance is the 8x16 half-scale figure (was the squat 16x16) and the far one a 4x8 quarter-scale figure, switching where neighbouring sizes are equally wrong, so an enemy grows steadily as it approaches. Sentinel scenes show the new cels; 11_pickup_collected and 13_exit_beacon land on another simulation tick because the one-column middle cel costs less (the camera a step on, the beacon's other phase). Every frame check passes.
